name: Water tube boilers (Learn About Steam)
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Water-tube boiler characteristics: water inside tubes and gas outside, steam drum plus mud drum with downcomers/risers and membrane furnace walls; up to 160 bar, 500 kg/s steam output and 550 C superheat; alternative layouts 5,000-180,000 kg/h; gas-turbine exhaust about 500 C for waste-heat boilers. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/water-tube-boilers?sc_lang=en-GB
